hardware: 4x NVIDIA DGX Spark / GB10, direct-cable 200-Gb/s cycle
evidence_scope: Matched opening B0, M1, M3, Q8, closing B0, and adaptive MTP2/3 streaming benchmarks; four all-valid standard-harness quick 16K matrices for opening/closing B0, M3, and adaptive; a completed fresh-salt, clean-restart B0/adaptive three-window C8 pair plus earlier B0 variance and incomplete adaptive-repeat artifacts; a valid standard llm_decode_bench v0.4.31 B0 run and its invalid-timeout predecessor; and an AS cold-start gate observed in the live operator console. The incomplete old-salt adaptive repeat has two valid windows and one invalid window and is not a paired performance result. This is a completed public-functional-lane performance campaign, not a reference-lane result, public-bootstrap acceptance, a clean-checkout receipt, a release correctness pass, or a shared-H release. B0 remains the default and M3 remains a C2/C4 Pareto alternative only within the custom matched harness. The stock 128-token deterministic gate fails on a narrow token-124 divergence.
sanitization: Management addresses, SSH identities, hostnames, NIC assignments, host paths, filled profiles, dry-run plans, and raw logs are omitted. Public immutable identities, artifact hashes, sanitized settings, and result summaries are retained.

matched_harness.current_decode_repeat_harness_boundary: The current file adds the decode-only repeat mode used by R8 and both ADR8 halves, and was also used in full-matrix mode by AD and M1. It was not the harness bytes used by B0, M3, Q8, or BR and is not retroactively assigned to those artifacts.

standard_llm_decode_bench.evidence_boundary: This is a standard-harness public-functional-lane live result. It is not a reference-lane result, public-bootstrap acceptance, or a correctness pass. Raw diagnostics contain private site identities and are not committed.

standard_quick_decode_comparison.interpretation: The standard quick matrices do not reproduce the custom matched harness's M3 C2/C4 gains. Against the quick B0 bracket midpoint, M3 is effectively flat at C1/C2 and slower at C4/C8; adaptive improves C2 but regresses C1/C4/C8. B0 remains the default. M3's Pareto label is restricted to the custom matched harness and measured workload.
standard_quick_decode_comparison.evidence_boundary: These four artifacts use the standard harness with skip-prefill and different prompts/order from the custom campaign matrices. Their deltas must not be merged with custom-harness cells. Raw diagnostics contain private site identities and are not committed.

validity_notes.prefill: B0, M1, M3, Q8, BR, and AD use nine matched true-streaming TTFT cells with identical prompt hashes. B0/M3/Q8/BR use the original harness hash; M1/AD use the current extended harness hash. Means are descriptive for three repeats per size. AD had one measured-phase Triton JIT warning, and M1 had three warnings in its final 16K cell, so their prefill promotion claims remain caveated.
validity_notes.decode: B0, M1, M3, Q8, BR, and AD use one 25-second sample per concurrency; M1/AD use the current extended harness while the earlier four use the original bytes. M1 regresses decisively at every concurrency, so no repeat is required. R8 and both ADR8 halves use the current decode-repeat mode for three C8 windows. The prompt-matched ADR8 pair has adaptive/B0 medians of 60.48/61.04 tok/s (-0.92 percent) and means of 67.43/66.16 tok/s (+1.91 percent). Both combined lane sets fail fairness, so there is no robust adaptive gain. The earlier old-salt adaptive artifact has two valid windows and one invalid window; it cannot support a paired summary.
validity_notes.AS: AS console numbers are a failed readiness gate, not matched campaign benchmark data. Missing durable JSON is a material evidence limitation.
validity_notes.Q8: Q8 uses the same prompt hashes and harness as B0/M3. Its first 16K sample is retained in all means; fixed order and one decode sample per concurrency limit attribution.

runtime_correctness_caveat.observation: Repeated requests using the same fixed seed produced different greedy outputs on freshly restored B0 and on Q8. The final stock 128-token B0 gate reproduced a narrow divergence.
runtime_correctness_caveat.evidence_source: operator-recorded live canary, stock gate, localization, and logprob audit observations; raw logs not committed

bounded_120_token_gate.interpretation: Bounds the observed repeatability failure before token index 124; does not replace or waive the failing 128-token release gate.

runtime_correctness_caveat.boundary: This is a narrow repeatability failure at token index 124 near a tied or low-margin choice, not evidence of checkpoint corruption. The stock 128-token deterministic gate is not passing, so neither performance validity nor B0 default status may be described as release correctness acceptance.

final_disposition.pareto_alternative: M3 for the custom matched-harness C2/C4 workload only; not reproduced by the standard quick matrix
final_disposition.boundary: B0 remains the public-functional configuration default for this completed external campaign. This is not public-bootstrap acceptance or a release correctness pass.
